root_cause.text: The function pcs_add_gpio_func() calls of_parse_phandle_with_args() inside a loop, which increments the reference count of the returned device_node (gpiospec.np), but never calls of_node_put() to release it, causing a reference count leak on each iteration.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that "of_parse_phandle_with_args() returns a device_node pointer with refcount incremented in gpiospec.np. The loop iterates through all phandles but never releases the reference, causing a refcount leak on each iteration." The patch adds of_node_put() calls on the error path (when devm_kzalloc fails) and after the successful use of the node.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix device node reference leak in pcs_add_gpio_func error path by adding of_node_put when memory allocation fails.
intent_record.what: Added of_node_put(gpiospec.np) before setting ret = -ENOMEM and break in the error handling block when devm_kzalloc fails in pcs_add_gpio_func.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the reference count of the device node gpiospec.np is decremented when memory allocation fails, preventing a resource leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing of_node_put to fix device node reference leak in pcs_add_gpio_func.
intent_record.what: Added a call to `of_node_put(gpiospec.np)` after `list_add_tail(&range->node, &pcs->gpiofuncs);` inside the loop in `pcs_add_gpio_func`.
intent_record.how: This decrements the reference count of the device node obtained from parsing a GPIO specifier, preventing a memory leak by ensuring the node is freed when no longer needed.
